messages:
sophia: Heads up — starting novaX v1 onboarding into staging. We pushed safetensors shards to s3://redwood-onboard/novaX/v1/ but CI flagged a few issues. Can someone quick-check sharding layout and tokenizer mapping?
kevin: Looking — which sharding scheme did export use? TP=8 and staggered naming? :eyes:
mira: If it's staggered, we need to remap to our serve convention (tp-major). Quick diff shows axis order mismatch for Q/K/V weights. That will break KV cache.
jon: Can you paste a safetensors header check? I can run a small script. If index missing, packbot will fail.
sophia: here's quick check I ran locally:
```
python -c "from safetensors import safe_open; f=safe_open('shard_00_of_08.safetensors','rb'); print([k for k in f.keys()][:6])"
```
Output showed `['_metadata', 'transformer.wte.weight', 'lm_head.weight', ...]` but ordering is weird.
kevin: Also saw tokenizer.json had `added_tokens` array with offsets starting at 50256 instead of 50257 — off-by-one. That causes decoding shifts.
mira: For dtype, `model-config.json` currently has \"dtype\":\"float16\" but conversion directory used bf16. We need consistent dtype across model-index and weights. CI rejects mismatches.
jon: Proposed action items:
- I can run `reindex_shards.py --stagger-to-serve` to rewrite filenames + index. Will run and push a new index.
- @kevin will fix tokenizer added_tokens ordering or provide map.
- @sophia can update model-config dtype flag.
sophia: go for it. Also please run a quick smoke generate on staging (short prompt) after repack.
packbot: deploy-check started for s3://redwood-onboard/novaX/v1/ — checksum mismatch on shard_03_of_08.safetensors :warning:
kevin: That shard got truncated — reuploading now.
mira: After reupload, also run `python tools/validate_tp_layout.py s3://redwood-onboard/novaX/v1/ --tp 8` — it checks expected axis order and kv shape.
jon: I'll open a tiny PR to our packaging scripts to add an automated remap step when `--stagger` detected. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/weights-tools/pull/732 :eyes: Please review.
sophia: Thanks. Ping me when smoke generate passes. If both kv order and tokenizer fixed we can mark onboarding ready for canary.
kevin: reupload done, packbot succeeded. :tada:
packbot: smoke-generate (prompt "Hello") returned coherent output, latency 210ms on staging instance.
mira: marking checklist: shard names normalized ✅ index regenerated ✅ tokenizer map applied ✅ dtype normalized ✅ smoke-generate ✅
sophia: Awesome — merging PR and tagging release notes. Thanks all. :shipit:
